variable name: # EG4 LL-S 48V 100Ah Rack Battery - HOLDING Registry Map
# BMS configuration and protection threshold registers
# Base addr: 0x002D (45 decimal)  |  Function code: 0x03 read / 0x06 write
# Write access: all entries are READ only by default.
# To enable write on a specific register
data type: change its writable field to W.

variable name: # Use extreme caution — incorrect protection thresholds can damage cells
# or cause the BMS to fail to protect against overcurrent / overtemperature.

note: Minimum cell voltage (mV) that must be reached before balancing begins. Multiply raw by 0.001 for volts (e.g. 3400 = 3.400V)
Maximum cell voltage spread (mV) tolerated before active balancing is triggered. Multiply raw by 0.001 (e.g. 40 = 0.040V delta)
State of Charge percentage threshold below which a low-capacity warning is issued
Cell undervoltage WARNING threshold (mV). BMS issues warning when any cell drops below this. Multiply raw by 0.001 for volts
Cell undervoltage PROTECTION threshold (mV). BMS opens discharge FET when any cell drops below this. Multiply raw by 0.001
Cell undervoltage RELEASE threshold (mV). BMS re-enables discharge FET once all cells recover above this. Multiply raw by 0.001
Pack undervoltage WARNING threshold (V x100). BMS issues warning when pack voltage drops below this. Multiply raw by 0.01 for volts
Pack undervoltage PROTECTION threshold (V x100). BMS opens discharge FET when pack drops below this. Multiply raw by 0.01
Pack undervoltage RELEASE threshold (V x100). BMS re-enables discharge FET when pack recovers above this. Multiply raw by 0.01
Cell overvoltage WARNING threshold (mV). BMS issues warning when any cell exceeds this. Multiply raw by 0.001 for volts
Cell overvoltage PROTECTION threshold (mV). BMS opens charge FET when any cell exceeds this. Multiply raw by 0.001
Cell overvoltage RELEASE threshold (mV). BMS re-enables charge FET once all cells drop below this. Multiply raw by 0.001
Pack overvoltage WARNING threshold (V x100). BMS issues warning when pack voltage exceeds this. Multiply raw by 0.01 for volts
Pack overvoltage PROTECTION threshold (V x100). BMS opens charge FET when pack exceeds this. Multiply raw by 0.01
Pack overvoltage RELEASE threshold (V x100). BMS re-enables charge FET when pack drops below this. Multiply raw by 0.01

variable name: # Raw unit is 0.01A for current values; seconds for delay values.

note: Charge overcurrent level 1 PROTECTION threshold (0.01A). Sustained beyond charge_oc1_delay_s triggers FET open. Multiply raw by 0.01 for amps
Discharge overcurrent level 1 PROTECTION threshold (0.01A). Sustained beyond discharge_oc1_delay_s triggers FET open. Multiply raw by 0.01
Load short-circuit detection threshold (0.01A). Instantaneous overcurrent above this trips the BMS immediately. Multiply raw by 0.01
Charge overcurrent level 2 PROTECTION threshold (0.01A). Higher than OC1; shorter delay before trip. Multiply raw by 0.01
Discharge overcurrent level 2 PROTECTION threshold (0.01A). Higher than OC1; shorter delay before trip. Multiply raw by 0.01
Time in seconds the charge current must remain above charge_oc1_protect before the BMS opens the charge FET
Time in seconds the charge current must remain above charge_oc2_protect before the BMS opens the charge FET
Time in seconds the discharge current must remain above discharge_oc1_protect before the BMS opens the discharge FET
Time in seconds the discharge current must remain above discharge_oc2_protect before the BMS opens the discharge FET

variable name: # Raw values are signed integers with a -50 offset applied by the BMS.
# Stored value = actual_°C + 50. Transport subtracts 50 during processing.

note: Charge undertemperature WARNING threshold (°C). BMS issues warning when cell temp drops below this during charging
Charge undertemperature PROTECTION threshold (°C). BMS opens charge FET to prevent charging below this temperature
Charge undertemperature RELEASE threshold (°C). BMS re-enables charging once temp recovers above this
Charge overtemperature WARNING threshold (°C). BMS issues warning when cell temp exceeds this during charging
Charge overtemperature PROTECTION threshold (°C). BMS opens charge FET to prevent charging above this temperature
Charge overtemperature RELEASE threshold (°C). BMS re-enables charging once temp drops below this
Discharge undertemperature WARNING threshold (°C). BMS issues warning when cell temp drops below this during discharge
Discharge undertemperature PROTECTION threshold (°C). BMS opens discharge FET to prevent discharge below this temperature
Discharge undertemperature RELEASE threshold (°C). BMS re-enables discharge once temp recovers above this
Discharge overtemperature WARNING threshold (°C). BMS issues warning when cell temp exceeds this during discharge
Discharge overtemperature PROTECTION threshold (°C). BMS opens discharge FET to prevent discharge above this temperature
Discharge overtemperature RELEASE threshold (°C). BMS re-enables discharge once temp drops below this
PCB/MOSFET overtemperature WARNING threshold (°C). BMS issues warning when board temperature exceeds this
PCB/MOSFET overtemperature PROTECTION threshold (°C). BMS opens both FETs when board temperature exceeds this
PCB/MOSFET overtemperature RELEASE threshold (°C). BMS re-enables FETs once board temperature drops below this
